name: Teagan
source:
Teagan is one of the contestants of America's Most Eligible. She makes her first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 1.

Teagan is shown to be very bubbly and spiritual when first introduced to Your Character. While she is a very happy person, she knows how to defend herself, as she doesn't tolerate Bianca Sandoval's behavior towards her in the closing moments of Chapter 2.

Depending on who the player chooses to eliminate in Chapter 2, Teagan may either be a consistent presence throughout the first book, or absent for most of it.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Teagan]Wiki[/url]]
